body.name: Finite conditional Gaussian face--knot experiment
body.construction: Condition on \(\mathscr S_\eta=\sigma(\eta)\). For \(\theta\in\Gamma_\eta\), draw \((g,Z)\sim N(0,\Sigma_\eta)\) with independent pre and post blocks, form \(\mathsf X_{\eta,\theta}\) from the shifted pre coordinate and shared-noise knot-group coordinates, and denote its conditional law by \(\Pr_{\eta,\theta}\). The statistic \(\eta\) contains every within-cell offset difference exactly; \(\theta\) contains only cross-cell group translations and simplex-face offsets.
